word/document.xml.1: This document specifies the cleaning validation requirements for tibial impact broach handles.
word/document.xml.2: It applies to Class IIa devices under MDR (EU) 2017/745.
word/document.xml.4: 2.1 Cleaning validation means the process of demonstrating that a cleaning process is effective by testing for residues.
word/document.xml.6: Residue limits shall not exceed 10 μg/cm², and endotoxin shall remain below 0.5 EU/mL.
